components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Native-widget visual treatment; actual padding is supplied by Streamlit.
components.css: .ds-button { font-family:Inter,sans-serif;border-radius:8px;min-height:2.65rem;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--border,#30394e);background:var(--raised,#252a39);color:var(--ink,#dee2f6);transition:background 180ms ease-out,border-color 180ms ease-out; }.ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan,#22d3ee);outline-offset:3px; }@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none;}}.ds-button:hover { border-color:#65d9ed;color:#a2eeff;background:#27374c; }.ds-button:disabled { opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Gradient action treatment; form submit uses a taller minimum height.
components.css: .ds-button { font-family:Inter,sans-serif;border-radius:8px;min-height:2.65rem;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--border,#30394e);background:var(--raised,#252a39);color:var(--ink,#dee2f6);transition:background 180ms ease-out,border-color 180ms ease-out; }.ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan,#22d3ee);outline-offset:3px; }@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none;}}.ds-primary { background:linear-gradient(105deg,#16cbe6,#8aebff 65%,#d0bcff);color:#00252e;border:0; }.ds-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.08);color:#001f25; }

narrative.overview:
The visual authority is the user-supplied `stitch_ciphervault_ui_design_system.zip`: the File Vault and animated Sign In / Unlock screens. This implementation adapts the export to native Streamlit controls and real vault data. Navy surfaces, cyan actions, violet accents, geometric headings and monospaced cryptographic metadata carry the supplied identity. No additional creative metaphor is established.

The sign-in illustration and workspace lock artwork carry the vault motif; working controls stay native Streamlit widgets. Sources of truth are `ui.css`, `ui.py`, `.streamlit/config.toml` and the layout in `app.py`. Product and security facts remain in `README.md` and `vault.py`.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal layers with cyan interaction emphasis.
Rounded file cards, inset metadata and a separate cryptographic inspector.
Locally bundled type and an isolated animated sign-in vault.
Role-aware controls and truthful verification states.
dos: Do preserve the supplied navy/cyan/violet identity and established font roles.
Do retain native Streamlit actions and escaped file metadata.
Do describe SHA-256 values as upload metadata until live verification succeeds.
Do apply batch verification to all matching filtered files and report individual failures; keep guest controls metadata-only.
Do share these tokens and native widget styling across bootstrap, overview, account, team access, audit and security pages.
Do preserve local asset licenses, animation controls and the WebGL fallback.
donts: Don't restore mockup sample users, a role switcher or artificial integrity badges.
Don't introduce unsupported hardware-enclave, FIPS or zero-knowledge claims; authentication and cryptography remain implemented by `vault.py`.
Don't treat the decorative vault scene as a security boundary or pass credentials or vault data into it.
